Gerard opens up about his time in the Big Brother Naija Season 11 house and addresses the moments that got people talking.

In this exit interview, Gerard explains why he chose not to pursue Oyin romantically, revealing that he felt it was not the right time or place. He also reacts to his unexpected kiss with Sheba and shares why the moment came as a shock to him.

videos.title: Diva Yetty Is Everyone's Unpaid Therapist | One More Thing
videos.headline: Diva Yetty Is Everyone's Unpaid Therapist | One More Thing
videos.description:
In this episode of One More Thing, Lulu Manuel sits down with writer, creator and community builder Diva Yetty for an honest conversation about growing up as a firstborn daughter, always being the person everyone turns to, and learning to choose yourself.

Diva Yetty talks about growing up feeling responsible for her family and carrying the emotional weight that came with being the oldest daughter. She also shares how she turned her relatable social media rants into a writing career and built a community that now looks to her for advice.

From learning to set boundaries to understanding her own mother better as she grew older, Diva shares the lessons that have shaped who she is today.

She also gets real about ambition, relationships, and why she would rather be alone than settle for something that doesn’t feel right

#Zikoko #Zikokomag #divayetty #firstborngirl #firstborndaughters
